provenance: LAB_AUTHORED by the E2 orchestrator on 2026-10-12 for experiment E2 only. Not approved organizational policy, not a contract, no real authority. Retail data in the referenced warehouse are synthetic.

clauses.H1: Report cash-collected revenue for each calendar year of order date: the value (quantity times unit price charged) of order lines belonging to completed orders for which the customer's payment has been received in full, as evidenced by a payment record.
clauses.H2: For each calendar year of order date, report the gross profit (unit price charged minus the product's unit cost, multiplied by the units on the line) earned on completed orders of products in the Electronics category.
clauses.H3: Report, for each calendar year of order date, the revenue from completed orders that is attributable to the French market.
clauses.H4: For each calendar year of order date, report the total number of product units sold on orders booked to stores located in Germany, whatever the sales channel, excluding cancelled orders.
clauses.H5: Report, for each calendar year of order date, the revenue (quantity times unit price charged) from completed orders placed by customers whose registered e-mail address is on the gmail.com domain.
clauses.H6: Report, for each calendar year of order date, the number of distinct orders placed through the online channel by customers whose country of residence is France, regardless of order status.
